stateAndTrust.inventoryInitialLoading: No retained data plus query.isLoading drives brief loading and table/status skeletons. PageLayout receives query metadata, not replacement loading/error props, so the mounted children are not globally gated.
stateAndTrust.inventoryInitialError: useDataState.fatalError is shown with retry in the summary and both table/status panel shells; brief hasData=false yields unknown metrics rather than loaded counters.
stateAndTrust.inventoryRefetchError: Retained rows, selected IDs, status and summary remain; fatalError=null and StaleRefreshWarning exposes refreshError. The brief labels retained rules.
stateAndTrust.inventoryPausedCache: deriveDataState marks retained paused data stale and isRefreshBlocked=true; page requests retained brief state and source warning. Cached/offline operational mode disables the page write controls.
stateAndTrust.inventorySuccessfulEmpty: A genuine [] is data, so total zero is meaningful; table/status keep first-rule empty states. Filtered zero differs from empty inventory.
stateAndTrust.malformed: safeArray turns null/object roots into successful [], does not validate array elements, and no list schema assertion exists. AL-S05; missing known wire fields are separately AL-S01.
stateAndTrust.vehicles: Independent initial loading and fatal error/retry are visible; retained names and stale warning survive failed refresh. Unknown lookup uses Vehicle #id; missing vehicle_id means fleet-wide per Go pointer omission.
stateAndTrust.routinesAndPlaces: Template isError replaces retained cards, zero templates returns null, and geofence hook state is ignored. AL-S04, not a claim that a real request failed.
stateAndTrust.live: This is a polled rule inventory, not an execution stream. STANDARD is 30000ms; brief explicitly says not a live execution stream. No page SSE/EventSource construction.
stateAndTrust.replay: Global operational mode normalizes as_of and disables actions. List, vehicle and place hooks use current inventory keys/URLs without as_of. Historic reconstruction for this inventory is not proven; AL-C03 is a separate integration candidate.
stateAndTrust.requestBoundary: Bulk POST opts into requiresLiveMode and always network mode. Routine install lacks requiresLiveMode while central gate is opt-in: AL-S07. Shared mutation defaults already use always and retry 0; no queued/replayed routine request is asserted.

sourceFindings.title: Actual list wire lacks the counters, auto-disabled state and last-triggered fields required by the accepted page
sourceFindings.mechanism: List discards AutomationFull down to its base Automation and wraps only next_fire_time/conflicts. The base JSON has no execution_count, failure_count, auto_disabled or last_triggered_at. No DTO marshaler supplying these fields was found in the bounded handler directory lookup. Page sums absent counters as 0, treats absent auto_disabled as false, and shows missing last-triggered as dash. Thus a valid current handler response makes cumulative counters appear measured zero and the auto-disabled filter/band uninformative; camelCaseKeys cannot manufacture omitted fields.
sourceFindings.testEvidence: Existing page/table fixtures fabricate required counter and auto-disabled fields and double-cast into Automation; mocked hooks do not test the actual List wire.
sourceFindings.minimalBoundedFixScope: Align the list DTO/hook/type and page-derived counters/status contract. Keep every accepted band; represent genuinely unavailable counters/status/time as unknown rather than zero/false, and restore their functional data only through an approved narrow existing-history aggregation in the automation list owner. Scope would include automation List/DTO and directly consuming Automation type/page/table/brief/status; no new telemetry storage, legacy adapters or unrelated endpoint campaign.
sourceFindings.runtimeObservation: None. This is a deterministic current-source wire mismatch, not a claim about deployed API data.

sourceFindings.title: Rule name links target an unmounted route instead of the registered editor
sourceFindings.mechanism: Name Link emits /automations/{id}. Actual App registers /automations/:id/edit, not /automations/:id; unmatched routes go to NotFound. The existing table test explicitly asserts the wrong href, so its source does not contradict this defect.
sourceFindings.minimalBoundedFixScope: AutomationListTable name Link destination plus its existing href assertions only; use /automations/${id}/edit. Do not introduce a duplicate page or new route solely to preserve the broken link.

sourceFindings.title: Filtered bulk scope does not include the table's internal filters
sourceFindings.mechanism: effectiveSelected and matching loaded rule count use only page status/name-description filtered. DataTable further searches rendered columns and filters values without notifying this page's scope derivation, and intentionally keeps nonmatching selected IDs. For example, select A/B, then table-local filter hides B: toolbar still labels both eligible IDs as filtered selection and bulk submission includes B. Its matching denominator can disagree with table/footer results. No operation was executed.
sourceFindings.minimalBoundedFixScope: Page/table integration must either use one controlled matching-ID pipeline for all existing filter capabilities or explicitly label and review retained hidden selections before bulk actions. Preserve full-loaded summary, pagination, value filters and select-all semantics; do not globally change DataTable selection behavior for unrelated consumers.
sourceFindings.testEvidence: Page tests stub the table and only exercise outer filter pruning; table tests exercise local value filters separately, not the composed bulk scope.

sourceFindings.title: Routine band conflates place failure/loading with empty and discards retained catalogue content
sourceFindings.mechanism: Geofence query is destructured for data only, so undefined on loading or initial error becomes places=[] and the create-a-geofence message, without source error/retry. Retained place refresh errors are silent. Template isError unconditionally returns QueryError even if routines are retained. A successful empty template list returns null, leaving the outer panel without heading or meaningful empty state.
sourceFindings.minimalBoundedFixScope: RoutineWizard only and its existing test: consume existing per-source DataState, preserve section identity/retained templates, and distinguish independent initial/refresh failure, loading, paused and genuine empty with existing shared feedback/retry components.
sourceFindings.testEvidence: RoutineWizard.test.tsx currently has two cases: selected-place install and successful empty places; no retained/error/empty-template source coverage.

sourceFindings.title: Malformed list roots become authoritative empty inventories while malformed rows remain unchecked
sourceFindings.mechanism: select:safeArray maps a successful object/null list body to [] without an error, so hasData=true and the inventory reads real zero/empty. It passes arrays unchanged: [null] crashes page stats at a.auto_disabled, and a malformed routine without actions crashes actions.length. This is a deterministic conditional malformed-input mechanism, not evidence that a server currently returns malformed values.
sourceFindings.minimalBoundedFixScope: Narrow automation inventory/template response assertions at their hook boundary, validating actual supported row fields without requiring nonexistent extension counters. Throw on invalid envelope/rows so existing retained DataState survives. Do not change global safeArray semantics or validate all unrelated domains.

sourceFindings.title: Five table data columns have no source-backed mobile detail reachability
sourceFindings.mechanism: The page passes mobileColumns=['name','status'] and no mobilePresentation or expandable row detail. Shared table applies hidden md:table-cell to other headers/cells regardless of column chooser layout. Thus description, vehicle, runs, failures and last-triggered disappear below md with no page-provided way to read them in situ. CSV download and a broken editor link are not a mobile detail view.
sourceFindings.minimalBoundedFixScope: AutomationListTable and existing test only: adopt the existing DataTable mobilePresentation/detail contract and preserve all seven values, multi-selection, filters, pagination and export. No shared primitive redesign.
sourceFindings.nativeCaveat: Source-defined visibility is confirmed; exact allocated width, native screenshot and practical target/focus behavior were not measured.

sourceFindings.title: Routine install omits the request-boundary live-mode guard used by bulk actions
sourceFindings.mechanism: Page disables install in cached/as_of UI, but useInstallRoutine POST never sets requiresLiveMode. Central assertOperationalWriteAllowed explicitly returns when this opt-in is false, and the secondary offline unsafe path allowlist does not cover automations. The hook therefore cannot recheck historical/offline mode at dispatch independently of potentially stale UI state or another caller. Shared mutation defaults already prevent paused/retried replay; no replay event or UI bypass was exercised.
sourceFindings.minimalBoundedFixScope: Existing useInstallRoutine request option requiresLiveMode:true and focused existing hook/guard regression scope only; retain current mutation defaults, endpoint and request body. No real install.

sourceFindings.title: Bulk success toast ignores per-ID failures even when the backend confirms zero changes
sourceFindings.mechanism: HTTP 200 can return updated/deleted=0 with every requested ID in failed[]. Hook onSuccess names the response _data and always emits Automations enabled/disabled/deleted. The page now correctly keeps failed IDs and shows their reasons, but the unconditional toast can still falsely announce a successful operation alongside those failures.
sourceFindings.minimalBoundedFixScope: useBulkAutomationsUpdate onSuccess outcome copy/severity and existing hook tests only; inspect updated/deleted and failed while preserving list/history invalidation. Do not undo accepted failed-ID retention.
